calls.statement:
WITH h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
ex AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
hm AS (SELECT h.member_id,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member m WHERE m.member_id=h.member_id) AS versions,
  (SELECT bool_or(m.marketing_consent) FROM dim_member m WHERE m.member_id=h.member_id AND m.valid_from<=DATE '2025-11-24' AND m.valid_to>=DATE '2025-11-24') AS consent_at_start,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member m WHERE m.member_id=h.member_id AND m.valid_from<=DATE '2025-11-24' AND m.valid_to>=DATE '2025-11-24') AS n_valid_at_start
 FROM h)
SELECT count(*) AS holdout_members,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE versions=0) AS not_in_dim,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE n_valid_at_start=0) AS none_valid_at_start,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE n_valid_at_start>1) AS multi_valid,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE consent_at_start) AS consent_true,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE consent_at_start IS NOT TRUE) AS consent_not_true,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM ex) AS exposed_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM ex WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM h)) AS exposed_and_held_out,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) AS exp_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_campaign_contact_load WHERE campaign_id=15) AS stg_rows
FROM hm

calls.statement:
WITH elig AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE marketing_consent AND valid_from<=DATE '2025-11-24' AND valid_to>=DATE '2025-11-24' AND join_date<=DATE '2025-11-24'),
h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
ex AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM elig) AS eligible,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM elig WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM h) AND member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM ex)) AS eligible_neither,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM ex WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM elig)) AS exposed_not_eligible,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM elig)) AS held_not_eligible,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15) AS rows_total
